leadIn: After completing this lesson, you will be able to:
objectives: Initialize a virtualized list component with a fixed height and scrollable container
Configure a custom hook to calculate visible items based on scroll position and viewport size
Manipulate the DOM by rendering only the visible subset of a large dataset
Apply dynamic styling to position items correctly within the virtualized container
Integrate scroll event handlers to update the visible range in real-time
Construct a reusable virtual list component that accepts data and item renderers as props
Control performance by implementing memoization for item rendering to prevent unnecessary re-renders
